acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: Chana talks with Nikole about what they both remember from being young parents just starting to think about schools for their children.
acts.credits: By Chana Joffe-Walt; Edited by Nancy Updike

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: Nikole talks with Chana about Najya’s elementary school and the problems her family navigated there.
acts.title: Nikole’s Choice

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Chana talks with Najya about her memories of elementary and middle school and how she felt about her mom’s choices.
acts.title: Najya

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: Nikole and Najya talk about what changed when Najya pushed back against her mom’s choices for elementary and middle school and got to choose her own high school.
acts.title: Najya’s Choice

acts.label: Act Four
acts.desc: Nikole and Najya talk with each other about the different choices they made and the questions they still have for each other.
acts.title: Nikole and Najya

acts.label: Act Five
acts.desc: Nikole fact-checks her memory against her old emails with Najya’s elementary school and has a painful revelation.
acts.title: The Evidence
